notes: Single-blade standalone appliance form factor (models S-MX4D-SDI4 / S-MX4D-SDI4-UHD), per official Haivision datasheet HVS-DS-MX4D-200601 (rear-panel photo + full techspecs table). Video outputs are 4x BNC labeled SDI 1-4, individually supporting SD-SDI through 12G-SDI (12G-SDI used for single UHD/4K output; 4x 3G-SDI used for up to four independent HD outputs) - grade set to sdi-12g as the connector's maximum supported grade. Audio is embedded within the SDI signal (SMPTE 272M/299M), not a discrete connector, so no separate audio port exists. No HDMI, USB, or serial/RS-232 control ports are present on this appliance - management is IP-only (HTTPS, SSH/Telnet, SNMP v3) via the RJ45 network port. The SFP+ cage is present on the rear panel but datasheet marks it "future use" as of this firmware revision - included here as it is a physical port. Power is an external DC power adapter (not shown as IEC/mains on the unit itself) - datasheet specifies 12VDC/18W for the single-blade appliance; the physical connector is a locking round DC connector (commonly cited as a Conxall-style 3-pin locking DC jack per Haivision accessory/parts references), which does not have an exact match in the given connector list - mapped to the closest available option, dc-barrel. Note: a separate "Rugged" Makito X4 variant uses a different Hirose 4-pin +28V connector - that does not apply to this standard single-blade appliance. Category was set to "converter" (encoder/decoder appliance) since "Encoder/Decoder" type is not in the category enum list; type is set to "Encoder/Decoder" which is the correct type match. Rack units omitted per instructions since this is a compact desktop/tabletop appliance (21mm H x 129mm W x 196mm D) rather than a rack-mount unit by itself (it can optionally slot into a 1RU 6-blade or 4RU 21-blade chassis sold separately).
